name: Favicons
description: generates and manages favicons/app icons for the site.
project_description:
This module allows you to upload 1 file that generates different types to be used as favicon. 

 Features 
 It'll generate:

 
 180x180 icon (apple-touch-icon) 
 favicon.svg 
 96.x96 icon 
 site.webmanifest 
 
 The module will automatically add the icons and manifest to the head of the website.

 Post-Installation 
 First, clear the cache. The module is installed and set to be on of the last for the hook-order (in Drupal 10). But that doesn't take effect until you clear the cache.

 After, you can upload your PNG favicon in the settings form and the rest is done automatically.
